resources.string: Translate visible text in a browser or another app. Scroll and tap through the translations with the lock closed. Choose Page changes to update after scrolling stops.
Read Japanese speech bubbles with a manga reader. Compact gives faster highlights; Koharu adds detailed masks and optional cleanup. Your previous manga reader is remembered.
Let taps and scrolling pass through
The small lock button stays accessible. Open it to move the handle, select translated text or open controls.
Allow screen sharing and display over other apps. No accessibility service, camera or microphone is needed. Protected video, banking screens and apps that block screenshots cannot be translated.
